Attack Vector: Modification of Gemfile.lock file to include a non-existent or malicious dependency
Indicators of Compromise: Unexpected changes in Gemfile.lock file, presence of a non-existent or unrequired package in the dependency tree

Method of Attack: Arbitrary code execution during install time
Attack Vector: Malicious Ruby gem that leverages native C extension to execute arbitrary code during installation
Indicators of Compromise: Unexpected creation of files in the system during package installation, presence of native C extension files in the package
